programs.name: MBA (Full Time)
programs.feeNote: Derived: AFRC Madhya Pradesh lists a semester-wise fee of Rs 43,000 for 'Shri Vaishnav Institute of Management and Science, Indore' (M.B.A.) for both 2026-2027 and 2027-2028; 4 semesters x Rs 43,000 = Rs 1,72,000 (regulated fee; other charges not included). A separate AFRC entry 'Shri Vaishnav Institute of Management, Indore Finance' shows fee 0.
programs.intakeNote: NIRF data submitted by SVIMS (header NIRF'2026'): sanctioned intake 300 for all PG 2-year programmes combined (MBA FT, FA, MM) in 2024-25.
programs.placementNote: Median salary of placed PG-2-year graduates as submitted by SVIMS in its NIRF data PDF (header NIRF'2026', file named Management_Report_2025): Rs 4,50,000 for 2024-25 (204 graduated, 140 placed); Rs 3,50,000 for 2022-23. The 2023-24 row shows 350000 in figures but 'Two Lakhs fifty thousand' in words, so it is not used. No official average published.

selectionProcess.name: DTE Madhya Pradesh online off-campus counselling on CMAT common merit list
selectionProcess.detail: SVIMS admission page: MBA (FT), MBA (FA) and MBA (MM) admissions are made by DTE MP through counselling on the CMAT common merit list, for MP-domicile, All-India and J&K seats. DTE MP Admission Rules 2026-27: graduation with min. 50% (45% for MP SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer).

selectionProcess.name: Further counselling round for vacant seats
selectionProcess.detail: If seats remain vacant after round one, the competent authority may hold a round on the entrance-test marks and/or qualifying-exam marks.

keyDates.notes: Counselling schedule is published by DTE MP (dte.mponline.gov.in); 2027-28 schedule not published as of 2026-11-12.
